description: Open-source web crawler and scraper for LLMs and AI agents: any website into clean, LLM-ready Markdown. Run it yourself, or use Crawl4AI Cloud with one key. Join our Discord https://discord.gg/VuxzM8mtf
summary: Crawl4AI is the ingestion layer I've been missing for Proreerfolio: point it at a job posting or a company page and you get back structured Markdown with citations and boilerplate pruned by a BM25 or LLM filter, so the résumé-grounding and job-fit checks read the actual content instead of choking on nav bars and cookie banners. The MCP endpoint is what makes it slot cleanly into PenguPool and AgentOn Pocket, because an agent I route through those tools can call /scrape or /extract without me wiring a headless-browser session into the orchestration layer. I appreciate that the whole thing runs locally with a single pip install and an async browser pool you can watch and tune, which is the local-first, trust-the-pipeline stance I try to keep in everything I ship.
